how.title: Indlela yokuguqula

how.step1.text: Cofa Khetha iifayile okanye utsale iifayile uzise kwibhokisi engentla. Ifayile enye okanye ezininzi ngaxeshanye.

formats.title: Iifomathi ezixhaswayo
formats.lead: Amakhulu eendibaniselwano zokuguqula kuzo zonke iintlobo zeefayile eziqhelekileyo:
faq.title: Imibuzo ebuzwa rhoqo
faq.a1: Ewe, isimahla ngokupheleleyo. Akufuneki ubhalise, ungene okanye usetyenziso.
faq.a2: Hayi. Lonke uguqulo lwenzeka ngqo kwibhrawuza yakho, ngoko iifayile zakho azisishiyi isixhobo sakho. Kungenxa yoko ikhawuleza kwaye iyimfihlo.
faq.a3: Imifanekiso (JPG, PNG, WEBP, HEIC, GIF, BMP, ICO, SVG, TIFF, AVIF), ividiyo (MP4, WEBM, MOV, MKV, AVI, njl.), isandi (MP3, WAV, OGG, M4A, FLAC, AAC, OPUS), amaxwebhu (PDF, DOCX, TXT, MD, HTML), iispredishithi (XLSX, XLS, ODS, CSV, TSV), idatha (JSON, YAML, XML) noovimba be-ZIP. Nayiphi na enye ifayile isenokucinezelwa ibe yi-ZIP okanye iguqulwe ibe yi-Base64.
faq.a4: Ividiyo iqhutyelwa yinjini yokuguqula ngaphakathi kwibhrawuza yakho, ngoko isantya sixhomekeke kwisixhobo sakho. Xa kutshintsha isikhongozeli kuphela (umzekelo MP4 ukuya kwi-MKV), sikopa umsinga wevidiyo ngaphandle kokuyikhowuda kwakhona, ngoko phantse kuyakhawuleza.
faq.a5: Khetha ifayile ye-PDF, uze ukhethe PNG okanye JPG. Iphepha ngalinye liba ngumfanekiso omnye, kwaye ungazikhuphela zonke ngaxeshanye njenge-ZIP.
faq.a6: Hayi kuthi. Umda kuphela yimemori yesixhobo sakho. Kwiividiyo ezingaphezu kwe-1–2 GB, ikhompyutha isebenza ngcono.
